site_reporting: all 40 sites separately; preserve groups and denominators; do not rank college quality
target: withdrawal by month 12 before transfer under no mentoring offer
uncertainty: finite frozen evaluation totals; no new bootstrap, population confidence interval, multiple-testing claim or universal transfer claim
